known_caveats: This is a complete admitted 12-of-20 cumulative reader boundary, not the complete edition.
HTML remains the primary accessible surface unless the admitted PDF receipt reports tagging.
Whole-book figure-provenance and complete-edition closure remain later gates.

package_authority_archive.omission_reason: The byte-preserving upstream archive contains legacy absolute author-workstation paths in 20 PDF metadata dictionaries; its exact identity and official commit/tree remain bound here without publicly redistributing those metadata bytes.

production_provenance.credit_note: Model provenance does not replace source-author, institutional, or human-contributor credits.
production_provenance.scope: translation drafting, original companion, modular backend, and edition QA
